title: Technology: How AI is shaping the future of the perfume industry
summary: There may be a hint of bergamot in the top notes and sweet iris as a follow-up, but there is a noticeable dose of Artificial Intelligence emerging in new perfumes, according to industry specialists. title: Clariant puts hybrid sun care innovation in the spotlight at in-cosmetics Asia
summary: Clariant has unveiled three new personal care ingredients at the in-cosmetics Asia trade show, which took place November 3-5 in Bangkok, Thailand. title: Scent Taipei 2027 puts Taiwan's growing fragrance market in the spotlight
summary: Returning from March 26 to 29, 2027, alongside Beautyworld Taipei, Scent Taipei will expand its showcase of international and local fragrance brands, offering a platform to explore opportunities in Taiwan's fast-evolving scent market.
